active = 0.

Turn the object into class AL (link group AH) at its own position.
handler_index = AH, animation = AL; clear the animation counters and state_frames.

Type 01h: an item that falls and bounces (not while 29F3 = 1).
Type 17h: a block that falls; landing fast shakes the screen (sound 12h); it can crush the player below. (guess)
Type 18h: moves by its direction; when the player comes near (and crouches or stands in its way) it starts to fall (sound 29h). (guess)
Death handler of breakable blocks: not solid, mark the spawn flag (esvc 33h), drop the item, state (animation 4, index 4), harmless, sound 1Bh.
Type 0Fh: a dropped item that falls; it blinks after 80 frames and disappears after 120.
Kind 1 (items): allow the pickup (contact_damage = 1) unless the item still flies up.
Type 04h: rope hook; a whip hit hangs the player on it (esvc_start_swing).
Type 05h: move down 4 while anim_frame <= 7, else up 2 on every second frame.
Type 06h: like ai_vertical_mover_7 with the limit 0Bh.
Type 07h: like ai_vertical_mover_7 with the limit 0Fh.
Type 0Ah: while the player stands on it, the counter +40h rises to 7 and pushes the player (esvc_set_2a13, table 131C); else it drops by 4. (guess)
Type 0Bh: set the hit box from table 1375 by anim_frame (animated hazard).
Type 0Ch: set the hit box from table 13AD by anim_frame.
Type 0Dh: set the hit box from table 13E5 by anim_frame.
Type 0Eh: set the hit box from table 141D by anim_frame.
Type 10h: harmful and solid only while anim_frame >= 0Bh (and +40h was not 1). (guess)
Type 09h: on the first frame spawn 4 debris pieces (classes 12h-14h) in random directions.
Type 08h: every 8 frames spawn 2 sparks (class 15h) in random directions.
Type 13h: destroy sequence: harmless, clear the strong enemies, sound every second frame; after 16 frames drop the item, become a spark, PPS sound.
Type 03h: keeps its place relative to the camera ([12]/[14]); between frames 28h and 5Fh it moves down and hurts. (guess)
Type 02h: moves by its direction, turns at walls and map attribute 10h, carries the player.
Move the objects with gravity that stand on this platform along with it. (guess)
CX += DX when the direction is right, CX -= DX when left (80h: no change).
